spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** The two fundamental natures — of good and of evil — [GAP-1] did spiritual death arise and establish its dominion [GAP-2] over the states of life? Or did it turn itself away from [GAP-3] its protective falsities [GAP-4] in its [GAP-5] yet it consummated [GAP-6] the two [GAP-7] natures altogether.

**¶2:** [GAP-8] it stirred what was latent and [GAP-9] those who dwell in the [GAP-10] of the natural mind wholly given over to falsity [GAP-11] — this was the first stage of its propagation.

**¶3:** Yet after a long duration, when there was no [GAP-12] restraint, falsity and evil welled up and propagated by influx [GAP-13] — the five genera of spiritual death that poured forth [GAP-14] — which are obscurity of understanding, self-love, false persuasion, falsity itself, and the utter absence of truth [GAP-15]. In the second stage [GAP-16] they were given determinate and fixed form [GAP-17] — those interior states in which spiritual death was grounded [GAP-18].

**¶4:** The fourth stage is the evil works [GAP-19] proceeding from the five perverted perceptions rooted in the five states of the realm of falsity from evil.

**¶5:** In the fifth stage, spiritual death extended itself into its generated forms existing in the five states of evil — those derivative affections that were shaped and brought forth from the five kinds of evil works of spiritual death. These are the five states of the selfhood, the five orders of falsity from evil in which spiritual death has been grounded. It extended itself into ten aspects: five pertaining to the active will and five pertaining to the receptive understanding [GAP-20].

**¶6:** Now, just as the realm of falsity from evil — in that its animating spirit and its [GAP-21] — they sustained the five genera of evil [GAP-22]; so also [GAP-23: REVIEW how] the ten aspects that exist in will and understanding — the self-love and concupiscence of the selfhood [GAP-24] — bind them, as they conjoin will with understanding in each state [GAP-25] — they were arrayed in opposition to the Divine Humanity. This is [GAP-26] the condemnation of the realm of falsity from evil: it was rejected to eternity.

**¶7:** Corresponding to the mystery of these twelve complete aspects of evil and falsity that arose within the realm of darkness [GAP-27] in opposition to the Divine Humanity — the twelve [GAP-28] — the twelve persuasions of error that originated from the twelve apparent truths of the natural heaven, now wholly perverted [GAP-29].

---

*Translator's note:* The "twelve signs of the zodiac" resist simple one-to-one correspondence. I read them as the complete circle of apparent truths visible in the exterior natural mind — truths of order that, when inverted by the realm of falsity, become the twelve systematic persuasions of error. Swedenborg associates the number twelve with all things of faith and the church in their completeness; here the correspondence holds in its opposite sense — a counterfeit completeness of falsity marshaled against the Lord's Divine Humanity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: the two essences [of Light and Darkness] Did Death arise and stand firm [...] up? Or else did it turn itself from [...] its armour [...] in its [...] but it finished [mixing] the two [essences].
[...] it moved it and [aroused] they that are in the [depths] of the earth of Darkness [this is the] first part.

Yet, after a long time, as there was not [rest], it gushed and streamed up [...] the five elements of Death that gushed [forth] which are smoke, fire, wind, water and darkness [...] the second time [...] they were sculpted [into] those in which Death was established [this is the third part].
The fourth part is the evil fruits [that are] in the five trees that are in the five worlds of the land of Darkness.

The fifth time it spread itself out to its creatures that exist in the five worlds; the ones that were formed and generated from the five fruits of Death. They are the five worlds of flesh, the five creations of Darkness in which Death has been established. It spread itself out to ten parts, five male parts and five female [parts].

Now, like the land of Darkness, in that its spirit and its [soul] they nourished the five elements [of Darkness]; this is also [how] the ten parts that are in male and female, the fire and lust of the flesh [bound] them, as they yoke them with one another [until] they were established against the First Man. This is [the condemnation] of the Darkness, it was condemned for ever.

Alongside the mystery of these twelve parts that came about in the Darkness [and were established] against the First Man. The twelve [parts are] the twelve spirits of error that came about from the twelve signs of the zodiac [...].

fills.explanation: The two essences in Manichaean cosmology are always Light and Darkness, corresponding to good and evil in the spiritual reading.
The mixing (mixis) of the two natures is the central cosmological event in Manichaean teaching, corresponding to the spiritual reading's 'consummated the two natures altogether.'
The chapter opens with 'the two essences' and this closing phrase circles back to the same term, confirmed by the spiritual reading's 'the two natures.'
Parallel to 'moved/stirred' in the preceding clause; the spiritual reading says 'stirred what was latent and [GAP-9] those who dwell,' requiring a verb of disturbance acting on those in the depths.
Standard Manichaean phrasing for the interior of the dark realm; the spiritual reading's 'of the natural mind wholly given over to falsity' corresponds to the depths of the earth of Darkness.
Connects to 'first part' to form 'this is the first part,' matching the chapter's pattern of identifying numbered stages and the spiritual reading's 'this was the first stage of its propagation.'

The spiritual reading says 'restraint'; in the Kephalaia register, 'rest' is the standard term for the quiescent state whose absence causes evil to erupt — corresponding to Swedenborg's 'peace' as the divine influx of order.
'Gushed forth' is the natural completion, matching 'poured forth' in the spiritual reading and the earlier 'gushed and streamed up.'
The spiritual reading says 'given determinate and fixed form — those interior states'; 'sculpted into those in which Death was established' naturally expresses the giving of determinate form.

The chapter enumerates five stages (first part, second time, fourth part, fifth time); the third is missing and this position — concluding the sculpting/establishment passage — is the structural location where it must appear.

Connects 'evil fruits' to 'in the five trees,' forming the standard Kephalaia construction 'the evil fruits that are in the five trees'; the spiritual reading confirms the fruits proceed from the five perverted perceptions.
Directly parallels 'five male parts' in the same sentence; the spiritual reading confirms 'five pertaining to the receptive understanding' requiring the matching noun 'parts.'

The standard Manichaean cosmological pair is 'spirit and soul' (pneuma and psyche) for the land of Darkness; together they sustain the five dark elements, corresponding to the active and receptive principles in Swedenborg.
Completes the standard phrase 'the five elements of Darkness' as used in ¶3; the spiritual reading confirms 'the five genera of evil.'

The editor's 'how' is confirmed: 'this is also how' introduces the parallel between the land of Darkness nourishing its elements and the ten parts being bound by fire and lust, matching the spiritual reading's 'so also.'

The spiritual reading explicitly says 'bind them'; the fire and lust of the flesh bound the ten parts, paralleling the yoking described in the next clause and corresponding to the conjunction of will and understanding in evil.
Temporal connector expressing that the yoking of male and female continued until the full formation against the First Man was established, matching the spiritual reading's consequential progression.

The spiritual reading says 'the condemnation of the realm of falsity from evil'; the next clause 'it was condemned for ever' echoes the same root, confirming the identification of this passage with the eternal rejection of the Darkness.

Mirrors the language of ¶6 ('they were established against the First Man') and the spiritual reading's 'arrayed in opposition'; the twelve parts came about in the Darkness and were established against the First Man.

Identifies the twelve parts mentioned in the preceding sentence with the twelve spirits of error; 'The twelve parts are the twelve spirits of error' is the natural appositive construction in the Kephalaia.
